title: 黒塔と湖
title_en: The Black Tower and the Lake

style.notes: Budget 1960s Japanese cartoon: speed lines, limited palette (red, white, black, gold, teal), thick ink, no photoreal Unreal cinematic. Gift for a daughter who loves Japanese things. Respect, not costume.

engines.why_not_unreal_first: Unreal is a studio bill. Same storyboard JSON feeds Godot now and Unreal later. Do not rebuild the plot twice.

moral.solomon: There is no Warrior. Just the Surgeon.
moral.kirana: 武は守り — the warrior fights for life.
moral.ending: Something is left, but a residue of love.

dojo.title: 道場
dojo.why: Gaming engine lets the story teach skills with the body. Fake fight. Real exercise. No bought sword tray — fight with what is around you. Japanese pilots fly F-35s; Jun’s sky is not foreign to that. Bare-hand, leopard, tai chi. Cartoon. Nobody is wasted.
dojo.disclaimer: Not a medical device. Not pose AI. Camera is frame-diff only. Not supervised martial-arts training. Not PT. Cartoon spar. Nobody is wasted.

skills.name: 豹歩
skills.coach: Root. Squeeze the ground. Do not bounce. This is exercise.

skills.name: 太極浪
skills.coach: Twist like the plunger — slow on purpose. Fast is a miss.

skills.name: 手元
skills.coach: No sword on the table. Pick what the room already has.

skills.name: 礼
skills.coach: Click is one palm. Not a flurry. Bow first. Bow after. Cartoon. Nobody falls down for real.
